# Vendored dependencies

`nlohmann/json.hpp`: JSON for Modern C++ **3.11.3**, MIT license (included).

Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.11.3

Header SHA-256:
`9bea4c8066ef4a1c206b2be5a36302f8926f7fdc6087af5d20b417d0cf103ea6`

The single header is vendored so project persistence and headless core tests work
offline without a package manager. No compiler or language runtime is bundled.
